passwordChanged: Password changed. Please sign in again.
lockUncertain: The lock state is unconfirmed, so the page remains shielded. Sign out and sign in again; do not repeat lock or unlock requests.
changeSuggested: Your password has been in use for a while. Consider changing it.
securityWorkspaceHint: Choose a security setting to verify your identity and make changes here.
totpHint: Enter the current 6-digit code from your authenticator.
verificationExpired: Verification expired or was cancelled. Sign in again.
authenticationBusy: An authentication request is in progress. Wait for its result.
totpDescription: New sign-ins require an authenticator code. Screen unlock still uses only your login password.
securityPasswordHint: Use 6–8 letters and digits, different from your login password.
scanAuthenticator: Scan this QR code with your authenticator or enter the key manually, then confirm with a code.
securityChanged: Security settings updated. Sign in again. Wait for the next code if the current code was used to confirm enrollment.
securityUnavailable: Security setup is not configured. Contact your administrator.
securityNoRecovery: Keep your authenticator safe. SMS, email and password-only authenticator recovery are not available.
securityResetHint: Reset requires your login password and a linked authenticator code. It is unavailable without an authenticator.
securityWriteHint: Saving ends all current sessions. You will need to sign in again.
securityInputError: Check password format, confirmation and authenticator code.
securityUncertain: The result is unconfirmed. Do not submit again. You can inspect current settings; sign out and sign in again before starting another security change.
disableTotpConfirm: Confirm disabling the authenticator and signing out
enrollmentExpired: Enrollment expired. Start a new enrollment.
securitySavedLogin: Security settings saved. Sign in again.
securityPending: An enrollment is pending. Starting again invalidates the previous request.
sessionRevokeUnknown: A session revocation is unconfirmed. Further actions on that session are blocked. Refreshing shows current online sessions but does not confirm the original operation.
